doc_type: DISCOM salient-features memo for TNERC Generic Tariff Order for GISS
title: Salient features/Guidelines for the Hon’ble TNERC’s Generic Tariff Order for Grid Interactive PV Solar Energy Generating System (GISS) – Order No.8 / 2021, dated 22-10-2021
number: TNERC Order No.8 of 2021 (memo number not printed on extracted text)
printed_date: Order dated 22-10-2021 (memo itself undated in extracted text)

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: All electricity consumer categories (except hut and agriculture) irrespective of tariff and voltage levels up to the level of sanctioned load/contracted demand up to a maximum capacity of 999 KW are eligible for solar energy net billing or net feed-in mechanism.
candidate_clauses.topic: capacity cap vs sanctioned load; kW ceiling

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: Consumer can install a maximum capacity of rooftop solar net feed-in plant upto 100% of his sanctioned/contracted demand.

candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: The cumulative capacity of all Solar PV systems under net metering or net billing put together connected to a distribution transformer shall not exceed 90% of the distribution transformer capacity.

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: connectivity to roo ftop solar systems shall be restricted to 90% of the distribution transformer capacity on the basis of first c ome first served.

candidate_clauses.note: Same 90% as 2019 memo: reaffirmation, NOT a numeric change (useful negative control for supersession edges).

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: VII.4 (power transformer limit, HT gross metering)
candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: The cumulative capacity of all solar generating systems under Gross metering mechanism in case of HT connected to a Power Transformer shall not exceed 70% of the Power Transformer capacity.
that can be set up under Gross Metering mechanism shall be 151 kWp up to a maximum capacity of 999 kW.
Provided that installation of Check Meter shall be optional for Renewable Energy Generating System with capacity up to and including 20 kW.

candidate_clauses.clause_ref: Annexure I timeline (site verification / technical feasibility)
candidate_clauses.verbatim_quote: Site Verification / Technical Feasibility & issuance of Letter of Approval (LOA) / Termination [1] DISCOM 15

amends_or_supersedes.evidence_quote: The feasibility intimation letter/ approval should be issued within 3 working days from the date of registration of application.

candidate_clauses.note: Annexure I is titled 'Suggestive Operating Procedures ... by DISCOMs' (appears to be appended MNRE-scheme procedure); whether it binds TANGEDCO net metering is unverified. Treat the 3 -> 15 working-day edge with caution.
